item.title: Solving the integration testing puzzle with contract testing with Bas Dijkstra
item.description: Come and join us by signing up on our meetup page: https://www.meetup.com/brighton-jug/events/299691382/ We are very excited to welcome Bas Dijkstra as a speaker at Brighton JUG. Bas is a Test automation trainer and consultant at On Test Automation. He will be giving a talk on - Solving the integration testing puzzle with contract testing Modern applications that are built out of loosely coupled pose some challenges in terms of integration and E2E testing.
